scope: Owned get/1, put/2 and erase/1 with native dictionary bucket layout, atom/small keys, compiler get instructions and GC roots.
adaptations: Retain ProcDict prefix field order and NIL/direct-pair/collision-list buckets. Independently owned stable metadata roots process-heap pairs/lists. Keep eight hash buckets rather than incremental rehashing; collisions remain real charged walks, not a cardinality-success stub. Atom and small-integer keys use native fast hashes; other key classes explicitly refuse even for an empty dictionary. get/0, erase/0 and get_keys are not admitted.

Absent keys return undefined; put returns the previous value, including undefined-valued entries. Immediate replacement is the native allocation-free mutation. Other updates reserve heap credit and reload buckets/arguments after moving GC before publish-last mutation; failure preserves dictionary contents. Erase unlinks exact keys and collapses singleton collision lists. No inherited dictionary state on process creation.

Every table slot is a collector root. Include those roots in work and code-lease marking bounds and alias checks, and release the owned metadata at process destruction. Boxed values, offheap binaries and external fun code leases therefore survive solely through dictionary reachability.

Project complete i_get_sd and i_get_hash_cWd cases with native operand/destination handling. Check cached fast hashes, use the shared allocation-free lookup, preserve destinations on profile/work failure, and account reductions before schedule-out. The verifier admits compiler get/1 with no exceptional guard edge; this is not an Erlang guard BIF.

Compiled fixtures, explicit X/Y assembly and independent OTP references cover roundtrip, collision replacement/removal, stored undefined, child isolation and repeated worker use. Component tests cover dictionary-only binary roots, code retention/unload after erase and GC, all mutation allocation/quota and primitive-work prefixes, heap-credit preservation, explicit key refusal and exact final balance. Worker tests retain exact/one-below budgets, peer survival and physical reclamation.
